products.title: Plaid Quarter Zip Jumper
products.body_html:
Cut from 100% brushed cotton flannel, yarn-dyed so the plaid runs right through the cloth, then garment-washed to soften it before it ever reaches you. Broken-in from the first wear, not the fiftieth. Built for cold starts, back nines, and everything after.

  • 100% french terry cotton. Warm, breathable, properly soft
  • Our very own Inner brush flannel collar lining
  • Garment-washed finish for a lived-in hand-feel and a faded, worn-in look straight out of the bag
  • Yarn-dyed plaid that runs through the cloth, so the pattern deepens instead of wearing off

products.title: Thermal Digital Camo
products.body_html:
Built for the early tee time, the cold back nine, and every round in between where the weather doesn't care about your plans. Our Digital Camo Thermal Base Layer locks in heat without the bulk so your swing stays yours, not the cold's.

Four-way stretch fabric moves with you. Flatlock seams that won't bunch under your layers. A slim fit that disappears under anything in your bag.

  • Four-way stretch thermal construction
  • Flatlock seam detailing
  • Slim, compression-friendly fit
  • Machine washable

Stay warm. Stay loose. Stay out there.

products.title: Clubhouse Pants - Olive
products.body_html:
Ready for the course but sharp enough for the clubhouse. Built from a premium nylon blend, these pants have the stretch and breathability to move with you every swing. The smooth woven finish keeps the fit clean, while a subtle water-repellent coating helps you stay dry when the weather turns. Relaxed through the leg with a straight cut made for all-day wear on and off the fairway.

  • Nylon spandex blend built for stretch, comfort and movement
  • Lightweight woven fabric made for warm rounds and long days
  • Water-repellent finish to keep you dry when the weather turns
  • Relaxed, modern fit made for every day wear
  • Front zipper pockets

MODEL - 6' - SIZE: 34
